title: feat(ui): five Studio pillars, the data source pages and the field types move into the studio i18n namespace (#25922 slice S4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8PeP4DzppH3b1kDPCjihHVx)_

Part of #25922

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 设计器表里 `engine.studio` 的 access、if、data、auto、settings 五个支柱，加上数据源三族（`engine.datasource` / `externalDatasource` / `datasourcePreview`）和字段类型三族（`engine.fieldType` / `fieldTypeDesc` / `fieldCategory`），共 en、zh 各 549 键，从 app-shell 私有表搬进 `@object-ui/i18n` 的 `studio` 命名空间，文案一字未改，调用点不动。
- 为什么改：执行 #25922 裁决 6431032267（Q2 = A，6431234244 维持），这是 (M) 的第 4 片（S4），派单 6450441124；`engine.studio.rules` 按席位改单留给 S5。
- 风险与回滚：与前几片相同，zh 用户首次打开这些页面时标签先显示英文、zh 分片到达后同一挂载重渲染为中文；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/en.ts` 末尾的 S4 段，再看钉测试新增的 11 个家族下限。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm run check:i18n-designer-parity && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/inspectorStrings.studioNamespace-25922.test.ts`，应全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Slice S4 of the (M) item.** These rows leave `ENGINE_STRINGS_EN` / `ENGINE_STRINGS_ZH` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` and are appended to `STUDIO_EN` / `STUDIO_ZH` in `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/{en,zh}.ts`, text byte-for-byte unchanged:

  | family | keys per language |
  |---|---|
  | `engine.studio.access.*` | 130 |
  | `engine.studio.if.*` | 58 |
  | `engine.studio.data.*` | 50 |
  | `engine.studio.auto.*` | 46 |
  | `engine.studio.settings.*` | 40 |
  | `engine.datasource.*` | 58 |
  | `engine.externalDatasource.*` | 50 |
  | `engine.datasourcePreview.*` | 10 |
  | `engine.fieldType.*` | 49 |
  | `engine.fieldTypeDesc.*` | 49 |
  | `engine.fieldCategory.*` | 9 |
  | **total** | **549** (same set in `en` and `zh`; none zh-only) |

  The five pillars are the seat's amended scope. `engine.studio.rules.*` is deferred to S5, because #26731 adds a `rules` row. The "about 500 key lines of other `engine.*`" are the data source pages and the field types: 225 keys per language, 450 key lines. I picked them because, when I read the open PRs' patches to both homes, no open PR touched these families. The open PRs that do touch those two files (#26804, #26827, #26819, #26831) hold only `engine.studio.{inspector,held,refusal}`, `engine.inspector.*` and `engine.translationPreview.*`. Stopping at 450 also keeps the PR under the 3,000-line threshold.
- Same AST pass as S2 and S3; a heading comment marks the S4 section in each catalogue.
- **No runtime change.** `lookupString` already asks the table first and the namespace second, so `t` / `tFormat` / `tOptional` and every call site are untouched. No new source file, so the console chunk groups need no change.
- **Readers.** Every non-test reader of the moved families is in app-shell under `views/metadata-admin/` or `views/studio-design/`, so all are Studio surfaces. None calls `t()` at module scope: `flowPresets.ts` and `field-types.ts` hold keys, not strings. Dynamic keys (`engine.fieldType.${…}`, `engine.fieldTypeDesc.${…}`, `engine.fieldCategory.${…}`) all go through `t()`. No stop-and-report.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/25922-studio-i18n-pillars-datasources.md`, `@object-ui/i18n` patch.
- ⛔ Untouched: `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`, `ui/.github/**`, root `ci.yml`, `engine.studio.{rules,inspector,held,refusal}`, `engine.inspector.*`, `engine.translationPreview.*`.

## Why

Ruling 6431032267 Q2 = A (upheld by 6431234244): the designer table becomes one lazy `@object-ui/i18n` namespace, moved in slices.

## Tests

- **Pin widened:** `inspectors/inspectorStrings.studioNamespace-25922.test.ts` gains a floor for each of the eleven S4 families. For each family, `t()` must answer every key with the namespace value in `en-US`, `zh-CN` and `de-DE`.
- **Forced edits: zh preloads.** Each of these suites reads a moved S4 zh row synchronously, so it now makes `zh` resident with a top-level `await loadStudioCatalogue('zh')`. No assertion changed:
  - Seven dom suites: `datasource/DatasourceResourcePage.locale-13460`, `previews/adminPreviews.i18n-10862-s2`, `previews/externalDatasourcePanel.i18n-10862-s3`, `previews/federationTabs.i18n-10862-s4`, `studio-design/ObjectFormDesigner.typeName-13148`, `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.emptyPackage`, `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.railLabels`.
  - One unit suite: `metadata-admin/studioAutomationCopy.plainLanguage-11659.test.ts`. It runs in the `unit` project (`isolate: false`), so it passed in the full run only because an earlier file had already loaded `zh`. Run alone, it failed.
- **Forced edits: tests that leaned on the table.**
  - `studio-design/AddFieldPopover.studioNamespace-25922.test.tsx` (slice 1) used `engine.studio.data.addField` as "a key still in the app-shell table". That key moved, so the test now uses `engine.studio.cancel`, which the same popover renders and which stays in the table.
  - `previews/__tests__/block-config-i18n.test.ts` floored the app-shell table at 1,500 keys. The table now holds 1,152, so the 3,000-key floor applies to both homes together, and the table only has to be non-empty.

### The sweep, and the S3 leftovers

Every app-shell test that names zh was run with `namespaces/studio/index.ts`'s `zh` loader delayed 4000 ms, using `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` and restored byte-identical. That is 403 files (the S3 list plus every other app-shell test naming zh). Each of the 52 unit-project files was also run alone under the delay.

- With this branch applied, 1 file goes red: `i18n/src/__tests__/studio-namespace-lazy.test.tsx`. It fails by construction, because its `findByText` waits 1 s and the delay is 4 s.
- Measured on `main` without the S4 move, 3 files go red under the delay: `PackageFormDialog.validationTiming`, `ResourceEditPage.discardDraftLabel-12690` and `ResourceEditPage.environmentOverlay-12141`. All three are S3 rows. The S3 sweep had no delay, so these racers passed locally. The seat routed their preloads to #26855 and #26839, so this PR leaves them alone. Until those land, they can show red here.

## Acceptance notes

- **Every moved key resolves identically before and after.** This is a one-off measurement and is not committed:
  - The 549 + 549 base values were read by AST from the table at `e9e344a9`.
  - They were compared with `t()` and `tOptional()` on this branch after `zh` is resident: `en-US`, `en`, `de-DE` and `fr` against the base `en` value, and `zh-CN`, `zh` and `zh-TW` against the base `zh` value.
  - Result: 3,843 lookups, 0 differing.
- **Ablations** (mutation landed by anchor count and blob, then restored byte-identical to `HEAD`):
  - With the `?? studioString(key, locale)` arm removed from `lookupString`, 23 tests go red: the pin's `t()` case for all 21 families, its zh-only case, and the equivalence check. The equivalence check reports 3,843 of 3,843 lookups differing.
  - With one moved zh row altered (`engine.datasource.title`), the equivalence check reports exactly 3 differing lookups (`zh-CN`, `zh`, `zh-TW`). The pin stays green, as designed.
- **Eager bundle:** not re-measured locally, as in S2 and S3. CI's `Build & E2E UI` measures it.

## Verification

All at the tree of `7c7bbb87`.

<details><summary>Tests and gates</summary>

- The 11 changed test files at normal speed: `Test Files 11 passed (11)`, `Tests 211 passed (211)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 34 commands, and each exited 0, including `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (`Test Files 178 passed | 2 skipped (180)`). `--ran` shows 34 derived, 34 run and 0 NOT-MEASURED. These gates ran with two more test files in the diff than `7c7bbb87` has: the S3-leftover preloads, which I later handed to #26839. Re-deriving on the final diff gives the same 34 commands.
- ui `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` (0 `en` values changed) and `check:i18n-keys`: all exit 0. `check:new-line-citations`: exit 0. `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs`: exit 0.
- Changed lines: 2,597 (+1,341 / −1,256) over 15 files, under the 3,000-line threshold.

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. No `packages/spec` change.
- [x] 2. No new names; the only new file is the changeset.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- [x] 4. One card slice, one branch off `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. Patch changeset with both declaration lines.
- [x] 6. n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to generated or release-owned files.
- [x] 8. English.
